race.comment: MAGNETIC ISLAND (8) continued her honest form with a solid third at the Sunshine Coast last start. Fitter again and suited by this assignment, she appeals as a genuine each-way chance. GRANDSTANDER (4) has shown enough in 2 runs back from a spell to suggest a win is not far away. He ran on strongly late for seventh last time out, finishing just 3.5 lengths from the winner, and with further improvement expected third-up, he should be right in the finish this time. IF YOU ASKED ME (7) did well off a bad draw on debut at Toowoomba, and he is nicely placed second up after a 4kg claim. Each-way. BODYSNATCHER (6) has attracted market support at recent outings without breaking through but he is still worth another chance. Include.
